purpose: Per-character animation clips that OVERRIDE the shared humanoid set.
why: Derived from the ROM's own animation-descriptor cascade in 0x02005C44 (actor vtable +0x24, the PlayAnimation the attack behaviour-state calls with state 0x2C). The cascade is: (1) action-row record +0x10 at 0x020F6BB8+row*0x24, (2) the body/motion record's set at +0x1C reached through 0x0208DAD8, (3) action-row record +0x0C at 0x020F6BB4+row*0x24 (the shared Blstr set 0x020E92DC), (4) the 630-set table 0x020EB7B8 indexed by actor+0x180. The action row itself is descriptor byte +0x05 of the 24-byte table at 0x020EF57C, copied to actor+0x6C3 by 0x02006288..0x020062A0. Each descriptor is 10 bytes {state, anim, attached, events, queued}.
how_to_extend:
python - <<'X'
import pathlib,re
for p in sorted(pathlib.Path('out/raw/archive/entries').glob('*.nsbca')):
    d=p.read_bytes()
    for m in set(re.findall(rb'<NamePrefix>[A-Za-z0-9_]{0,14}',d)):
        print(p.stem, m.decode())
X

clip_name_length: NSBCA names are 16 BYTES. Every clip name here is the truncated 16-char name as it appears in the archive and therefore in the exported AnimationLibrary. The previous Jango entries used untruncated names (JangoFettShootGun, JangoFettHoverIdle, JangoFettHoverMove, JangoFettHoverShoot); AnimationPlayer.has_animation() missed every one of them, so play_state() returned false and Jango's fire and hover animations never played at all.

fire_event_tracks.format: 6-byte records {u16 frame, u16 opcode, u16 param}, terminated by FFFF FFFF FFFF. Walked in ITCM at 0x01FFAE6C-0x01FFAEB8 and dispatched by 0x0209FA28.
fire_event_tracks.opcode_0x18: FIRE THE WEAPON, param = attach-point index. Posts event 0x0B to the behaviour state (0x02004B68); the attack state handles it at 0x02032740.
fire_event_tracks.opcode_0x02: positioned 3D sound, param = sound event id (0x020B95BC)
fire_event_tracks.note: NOT ONE fire clip carries a sound event. The fire sound is emitted by the PROJECTILE, not the animation - see fire_sound below.

fire_sound.where: 0x02018CBC-0x02018CD4, the tail of the projectile launch 0x02018AD8.
fire_sound.table: 0x020F4D0C, stride 12, indexed by the projectile subtype at obj+0x1C3 (= action-row byte +0x04).
fire_sound.field: byte +0x08 (literal 0x020F4D14 at 0x02018CF0) is the SOUND EVENT ID; 0xC9 (201) means silent and is the same no-sound sentinel as config/sound_events.json.
fire_sound.dispatch: FUN_020B95BC(id, projectile) - the positioned 3D emitter, source = the bolt.
fire_sound.hunters: every hunter except Bossk uses subtype 0/10/11 -> sound event 9 (out/snd/samples/sample_127.wav). Bossk's action row 4 byte is 13, which 0x02010C6C routes down the separate grenade branch (0x0200CB48) that never reaches 0x02018AD8 - his launch sound is UNRESOLVED.

cooldown.where: action-row byte +0x18 (literal 0x020F6BC0 at 0x0200E4E4), stored to actor+0x6C1 at 0x0200E480 and decremented once per tick at 0x0200E1D0.

target.evidence: body set 0x020E967C (all clips LOM_*); row 31 has no +0x10 set. NOT YET EXPORTED - needs a 4-LOM body library.
